name: Obrechjonnye na Bojnju
source:
One day, a gang of pioneers approaches Semyon, who is whiling away his eternity in Sovyonok, telling him that they want to escape this place and are recruiting new people for their team. And Semyon agrees. What exactly awaits him on this path to liberation?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3679105793]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一群拓荒者接近正在索维诺克消磨时光的谢苗，告诉他他们想逃离这个地方，并正在为他们的团队招募新人。谢苗也同意这一点。这条解脱之路上到底等待着他的是什么？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3679105793]Steam[/url]]
